artworks.title: Merci, ma vieille, trop décrépite! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two caricatures of elderly figures facing each other. The figure on the left is an elderly man standing upright with his hands behind his back. He has exaggerated facial features, with a prominent nose and chin, and short hair. He is dressed in a loose-fitting shirt and pants. The figure on the right is an elderly woman who appears to be leaning slightly forward while gesturing with her hand. She has a pointed nose, a crown on her head, and is dressed in a flowing gown that reads "Monarchie." Her gown and hair are covered by a long veil. She holds a book-like object in her hand. The background is plain with a faintly sketched floor, suggesting an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Et ces deux laids débris se désolaient entre eux
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals standing side by side. The person on the left uses a crutch and wears dark clothing with a head covering. The person on the right holds a cane and wears dark, flowing clothing. Both individuals lean slightly forward. The background is plain with a light texture. A border with text is at the top and a caption is underneath the figures.

artworks.title: Etrennes de 1856 ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in historic attire standing beside each other. One person, a man, has distinctive facial features and wears a dark suit with a hat in hand. The other person, a woman, has her hair styled up and wears a long dress. A small animal with rough fur walks in front of them. The background consists of vertical lines indicating a wall or curtain.

artworks.title: L'europe peut dormir tranquille ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of two figures. One figure is depicted lying down on a couch covered in draped fabric, while the other figure is standing next to them. The standing figure has short hair combed back, a stern expression, and is dressed in a dark, formal uniform with decorative elements. There is a table with a cup and a jug visible on the right side. The background features elaborate drapery. A caption is present at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Le député ventrigoulu
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man in a large armchair, leaning to his right with his head resting on his right hand while the elbow rests on the armrest. He appears lost in thought, with a furrowed brow and eyes looking downward. His hair is dark and curly. He wears a dark jacket with medals on the chest, lighter-toned shorts, and dark slip-on shoes. One leg is crossed over the other. Miniature figures are around him, including a boy with paddles on the armchair, a group gesturing on the left, and others carrying instruments in a parade to the right. A man conducts on a platform as they play. The background includes patterned drapery and a table with ornate legs, creating a stage-like setting for the scene.

artworks.title: Coulman en Alsacienne
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features a person standing confidently with their feet apart and arms at the sides, one arm slightly raised. The person has exaggerated facial features, wearing a headscarf tied under the chin. They are dressed in traditional attire with a blouse, fitted bodice, full skirt, apron, stockings, and flat shoes. The person holds a broom or similar object in their hands. The background is a gradient, and text surrounds the illustration.

artworks.title: Bataille (Alex. Simon Pataille)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person's upper torso and head in profile view, facing left. The individual has exaggerated features with pronounced cheekbones, a large nose, and a receding hairline styled in short curls. They are wearing a dark coat with a high collar over a white shirt, and a white cravat is visible around the neck. The background has a textured look with text, including the word "BATAILLE" beneath the portrait.

artworks.title: De L'or (J. -Ant. -Adrien Delort)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is an illustration showing the upper body of a person facing forward. The individual has pronounced facial features, with wrinkles and a broad forehead. The expression appears to be a smirk or grin. The person has thick, wavy hair and sideburns. They are wearing a dark coat with a high collar. Beneath the portrait, there's an illustration of metallic-looking tools and a horn arranged decoratively, accompanied by the text "DE L'OR". The background consists of fine text that appears to be a printed page, providing a backdrop to the central drawing.

artworks.title: Harlé Père, en buste
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body profile view of a person seated. The person is facing left, with a bald head and wearing round glasses. They are wearing a high-collared shirt and a dark textured coat. The background has faint text all over it. The name "ARLÉPAIRE" is displayed beneath the portrait in capital letters.

artworks.title: C'est toujours avec la plus profonde douleur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustration of a person from the waist up. The person is in a frontal position with their left hand placed on their chest. Their face is illustrated with strong shadows, emphasizing a prominent nose and brow, and the hair is covered by a tall, stiff headdress topped with a horizontal band. The clothing is formal, appearing to be a robe with wide sleeves and a white collar, suggesting an official or ceremonial attire. The background is plain, with a portion of text visible beneath the figure.

artworks.title: 2.000 fr...sans écurie...ça ne me convient pas!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals engaged in an interaction, one inside a doorway and the other standing outside. The scene is depicted in black and white. To the left, there is an older individual in profile, wearing a bonnet and holding a pair of glasses in one hand while the other rests on a door frame. They have a cautious expression. To the right, an individual with a long face and prominent nose is depicted in exaggerated proportions. They are dressed in a structured coat, a patterned vest, and a high-collared shirt, with a top hat tilted back on their head and carrying a book. French text can be seen below the image.

artworks.title: Vous êtes un jeune homme bien né!...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of two individuals shown from the waist up. The first person on the left is standing in a slightly hunched position, leaning towards the second person. This individual has exaggerated facial features, characterized by a large, prominent nose, and they wear their hair in a short, slicked style. The person is dressed in a dark, tailored jacket with a high collar and a bow around the neck area. The second person, seated on the right, has a stoic expression with one squinted eye and a full head of hair styled in loose waves. They are wearing a dark coat with a high collar and holding a stick or cane resting against their shoulder, while the other hand appears intertwined with the first person's hand. The background is a simple, neutral space with faint, drawn lines suggesting a soft texture. The overall tone of the drawing is monochromatic, creating a vintage appearance.

artworks.title: Il est charmant je vous dis...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two elderly women seated at a table. The woman on the left is in profile, leaning slightly toward the table, while the woman on the right faces forward with her body turned slightly to the left. Both women have wrinkled skin, elongated noses, and prominent facial features. The woman on the left has her hair tied in a kerchief, whereas the woman on the right has curly hair styled with large ringlets. They are dressed in dark, long-sleeved garments that cover their arms up to the wrists. The woman on the right holds a teacup in one hand, while the woman on the left gestures with her hands toward a small dog perched on the table, next to a plate. The background is a simple, lightly shaded area suggesting the interior of a room.

artworks.title: Souvenirs
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person lying in bed, positioned on their back with the upper body slightly elevated and head turned sideways towards a wall. The person's facial features are prominent with a long nose and a pointed chin, and they have a furrowed brow and closed eyes. They appear to be an old man, with a sparse beard on their face. They are wearing a nightcap on their head, and their clothing resembles nightwear, depicted as loose-fitting garments with visible wrinkling. Their hands are clasped and resting on their chest. Hanging on the wall beside them is an ornate framed picture of a woman, styled in a classical pose, with elaborate hair and attire that suggests an old-fashioned portrait. The wall has a patterned surface, and the background has dark shading, which contrasts with the light color of the bed linens and the person’s clothing.

artworks.title: Mon dieu! M'ame Bombec qué que vous avez attrapé?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two elderly figures are depicted from the waist up. The person on the left is leaning out of a small, recessed doorway, holding a wooden object, possibly a staff. They have a bandaged face covering one eye, long disheveled hair, and are wearing a dark robe-like garment. The person on the right stands facing the first figure with hands clasped together, appearing to listen intently. This person has sharp facial features, with a prominent nose, and long dark hair tucked under a headscarf that drapes around their shoulders. The background is minimal, mostly shaded, with faint text on the wall, indicating an urban setting.

artworks.title: Ca vous coiffe comme un gant!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an illustration showing two people from the waist up. The person on the left is standing in profile, wearing a tall top hat, with exaggerated facial features. They have a prominent nose, pointed chin, deep-set eyes, and short curly hair. They wear a collared coat with a high neck and no visible jewelry. The person on the right is in a three-quarter view, also standing and holding a shiny top hat in front of them with both hands. This person has a rounded nose, mustache, receding hairline, and short, slicked-back hair. They are dressed in a dark, fitted jacket with a high collar. The background features a repeating pattern of hat shapes, suggesting a hat shop. A header above them reads "TYPES PARISIENS".

artworks.title: Un coup de feu!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals, mainly focusing on their upper bodies. In the foreground, a man is seated with a displeased expression, his eyes half-closed and mouth drawn downward. He has long, straight hair that falls on either side of his face and is wearing a white barber cape. To his right, another person stands close, bending slightly toward him, holding scissors with their left hand. This individual has a jovial expression, with wide eyes and a rounded nose, and is dressed in a dark jacket over a light-colored shirt. Their hair is styled in large, coiled sections on either side of their head. In the background to the left, two individuals are engaged in conversation, dressed in dark clothing and facing each other closely. One has his hand raised to his chin. The background of the image features textured shading, and a hat is hanging on the wall near the barber's head. The entire scene appears to be a caricature, emphasizing expressive facial features and exaggerated body language.

artworks.title: Vous yoyez ici les grandes célébrités...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of several people in a theatrical or public performance setting. There are several full and three-quarter body portraits, including a man wearing a long coat and broad hat standing confidently with one hand gesturing with a long pointer towards a large sheet of music. There is a small audience with varied expressions. Another man leans over a large wooden barrel to the left, securing a hand on his bowler hat, with a startled expression. Behind them are several other figures. The background features dark, curtained panels with framed items on a wall, suggesting a theater or showcase environment.

artworks.title: Je t'ai épousé pour charmer mon existence...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image displays a full-body illustration of two individuals standing outdoors. On the left is a man with one hand in his pocket and the other holding a pipe to his mouth. He wears a tall black hat, a light-colored shirt with a partially open collar, a dark vest, and striped trousers. His facial features are rough and slightly obscured by facial hair, with a prominent chin. On the right, a woman is depicted standing with a basket on her arm containing items resembling loaves of bread. Her facial expression appears weary, and she has curly short hair. She wears a dress with a shawl, and another cloak over the shawl. Her left hand holds a bag. The background includes a rural setting with a windmill and shrubbery, suggesting a countryside scene. The illustration emphasizes detail in attire and posture, giving a historical context.

artworks.title: Et les cinq francs de ce matin?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white illustration of two people standing facing each other. The person on the left appears to be a man, wearing a sleeping cap and a loose garment resembling a nightshirt. The person on the right appears to be a woman, wearing a headscarf and a long nightgown or robe. Both figures have exaggerated facial features. The background is primarily shaded, with a suggestion of a curtain or drapery to the right. Printed text is visible beneath the illustration.

artworks.title: Dis donc amour! Crois-tu que ce sera un garçon. -Tu sais bien Clothilde que je te l'ai promis . . . Et  j'ai un tact  . . . Qui ne me trompe jamais!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man and woman sitting together on a cushioned bench or sofa. The woman is on the left, wearing a cap or bonnet, a long dress, and is knitting. The man sits next to her, smiling, wearing a jacket, waistcoat, and cravat. They are surrounded by an ornate architectural background.

artworks.title: Je me fiche bien de votre Mme Sand...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals: a man and a woman. The man is fully visible from head to toe, standing in a slightly forward-leaning position. His facial features include a prominent nose and short, unkempt hair. He is wearing a loose, long-sleeved shirt and holds a pair of trousers in his hand. The woman is reclined in a chair, visible from the waist up. Her profile shows a refined nose and neat hair styled in a bun. She is dressed in a long dress with long sleeves. In her hand, she holds an open book. The background consists of a simple setting with a folding screen positioned behind the woman. The image is rendered in a monochromatic tone, with the shading suggesting depth.

artworks.title: Une envie de femme grosse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic domestic scene where two individuals are engaged in a tug-of-war over a reluctant figure. The person on the left wears formal attire complete with a top hat and is pulling back. The person on the right is dressed casually, with an apron and rolled-up sleeves, and is straining in the opposite direction while balancing a large bundle on their shoulder. The central figure between them is adorned in a patterned dress and bonnet. The exaggerated expressions and dynamic poses add a lively touch to the image. The drawing likely offers a satirical take on daily social or domestic interactions.

artworks.title: Monsieur a sa bête, Madame son animal...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dining scene with animals. The drawing depicts a table set for dinner with two seated figures and two animals. On the left, at the table, is a dog being fed by one of the figures, labeled "Madame," while on the right, the second figure, labeled "Monsieur," interacts with a smaller animal that might be a cat. The figures are seated at a table covered with a white tablecloth, with plates, a wine bottle, and a glass on the table. The style is cartoonish and exaggerated, with elongated and slightly distorted features, creating a humorous or satirical tone. The composition conveys domesticity mixed with playful interaction between animals and humans.
